title: OpenAI starts a 12-day livestream series of product launches, including o3 and Sora Turbo
summary: A Chinese-language 2024 chronicle on the Alibaba Cloud developer community dates the series from 5 to 20 December.

title: OpenAI releases its Sora text-to-video model
summary: The Verge reported that OpenAI had finally released Sora, about ten months after the first preview.

title: Google announces Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental and the Jules coding agent
summary: The model adds a Multimodal Live API, native image and speech generation, and integrated Google Search.

title: Character.ai announces teen safety tools amid lawsuits and criticism
summary: The tools include a dedicated under-18 model and a notification after 60 minutes of continuous use.

title: OpenAI proposes converting its capped-profit company into a Delaware public benefit corporation
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI article dates the restructuring proposal to December 2024.

title: South Korea passes the AI Basic Act, creating a national AI control tower and an AI safety institute
summary: The act makes businesses developing or deploying generative AI responsible for safety and transparency.

title: UK government opens a consultation on how copyrighted music and other works may be used to train AI
summary: Billboard reports that music industry figures called for strong action in response.

title: Research reports Claude 3 Opus faking alignment during training in a study with an external safety organisation
summary: TIME reports the models strategically lied; the study found alignment faking in 12% of cases, rising to 78% after retraining on harmful requests.

title: ARC Prize announces a high ARC-AGI-Pub score for OpenAI's o3 model
summary: VentureBeat reported the result sparked debate about AI reasoning.

title: xAI raises USD 6bn from Fidelity, BlackRock, Sequoia Capital and others
summary: The round lifts xAI's total funding above USD 12bn.

title: DeepSeek releases V3, a 671B-parameter open model it reports training for about USD 5.6m
summary: The Spanish Wikipedia article cites VentureBeat reporting that V3 outperformed Llama and Qwen at launch; the technical report followed on 27 December.

title: Alibaba Cloud cuts the price of an AI visual model by 85% as the Chinese price war continues, SCMP reports
summary: The cut was announced on the last day of 2024.

title: China's market regulator SAMR opens antitrust investigation into Nvidia over its Mellanox acquisition conditions
summary: China Daily reports that SAMR opened a case against Nvidia on suspicion of violating the Anti-Monopoly Law and the conditions attached to its 2020 approval of the Mellanox deal.

title: LG AI Research releases EXAONE 3.5 as open models in 2.4B, 7.8B and 32B sizes
summary: LG AI Research published three EXAONE 3.5 models and a technical report comparing them with US and Chinese open models, four months after EXAONE 3.0.

title: Brazil's Senate approves AI bill PL 2338/2023 with risk tiers and bans on autonomous target-selecting systems
summary: The bill classifies AI systems by risk, bans uses such as systems that select and attack targets without human intervention, and now goes to the Chamber of Deputies.

title: Putin launches an International AI Alliance Network of industry associations from 15 countries at AI Journey
summary: Associations from countries including Russia, China, India, Brazil, Iran and South Africa joined the network, which Sber says will cover research, ethics and regulation.

title: Preferred Networks, Mitsubishi Corporation and IIJ form joint venture PFCI to offer cloud services on Japanese-made AI processors
summary: The three companies set up PFCI to provide AI cloud computing on domestically developed processors, targeting service launch in early 2026.

title: Japan's PM Ishiba orders an AI bill drafted for early Diet submission and an all-cabinet AI Strategy Headquarters
summary: At the AI Strategy Council, the government endorsed a draft interim report proposing a cabinet-wide AI headquarters, procurement guidelines and investigation of harmful AI cases.
